skills.name: Comet (隕星)
skills.line: This is what has been foretold by the stars.
skills.description: SP Susabi commands comets to fall on a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his attack.

upgrades.text: While the Galaxy of Fate field is active and when he uses a normal attack, increases the available Star Burst triggers by 1 (max of 6).

skills.name: Starry Galaxy (星羅雲布)
skills.line: Fate might be predestined, but fortune is made.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Susabi creates the Galaxy of Fate field. While it is active, he checks the prophecy at the start of a non-onmyoji enemy's turn. If an enemy shikigami does not spend any onibi, a Star Burst triggers dealing indirect damage equal to 72% of his ATK to all enemies. Then recovers 8% of his HP max HP and decreases allies' damage from normal attacks by 20%. Each time a Star Burst is triggered, he will gain 1 Power of the Stars stack. The field ends after 6 Star Bursts have been triggered. When the field ends, his move bar is increased by 30%. ;Power of the Stars (星辰の力) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 6 stacks. If he is inflicted with a control effect and has 3 or more stacks at the start of his turn, consumes 3 stacks to dispel or remove all control effects from himself.

upgrades.text: While the field is active, each Star Burst triggered increases the damage for the next Star Burst by 25% (max of 75%).
While the field is active, SP Susabi gains 40% of damage reduction.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses the this skill at the start of battle.

skills.name: Comet and Lightning (星流霆撃)
skills.line: From the stars, to the stars.
skills.description: SP Susabi commands stars to open up a black hole in a nebula and unleashes it onto all enemies, dealing damage equal to 127% of his ATK. Each Power of the Stars stack inflicts an additional strike on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 48% of his ATK. Then all Power of the Stars stacks are consumed. ;Power of the Stars (星辰の力) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 6 stacks. If he is inflicted with a control effect and has 3 or more stacks at the start of his turn, consumes 3 stacks to dispel or remove all control effects from himself.

upgrades.text: While the Stars of Fate field is active and when he uses this skill, increases the available Star Burst triggers by 3 (max of 6).
Additional damage ignores enemy soul effects.

bio.condition: With SP Susabi win 30 times in PVN zones.
